## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Satipaṭṭhānavibhaṅga* is the seventh chapter of the *Vibhaṅga*, the second book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Hazra 1994]. In the Pali Text Society edition, the treatise spans pages 193 to 207 [Anālayo 2010]. Like the other expositions in the *Vibhaṅga*, it is organized according to an analytical schema divided into three parts [Hazra 1994]. The text provides an Abhidhamma analysis of the four establishments of mindfulness (*satipaṭṭhāna*), yet it omits much of the expansive material found in the major canonical discourse versions—the *Mahāsatipaṭṭhāna Sutta* (DN 22) and the *Satipaṭṭhāna Sutta* (MN 10)—prompting discussion as to whether the compiled discourse versions postdate the compilation of the early portions of the *Vibhaṅga* [Sujato; SuttaCentral].

Curated cross-references link the text to DN 22, MN 10, and the *Adhiṭṭhānahāravibhaṅga* of the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 17) [SuttaCentral]. Text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus reflects this close textual relationship: the *Satipaṭṭhānavibhaṅga* shares extensive passages with DN 22 (512 matches) and MN 10 (506 matches), particularly between segments §19.1–19.3 and the corresponding sutta sections [DharmaNexus]. In addition, extensive reuse links it to neighboring chapters of the *Vibhaṅga*—including the *Bojjhaṅgavibhaṅga* (Vb 10), *Maggaṅgavibhaṅga* (Vb 11), *Jhānavibhaṅga* (Vb 12), and *Sammappadhānavibhaṅga* (Vb 8)—as well as the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* (Ds 2.1.8) and the *Satipaṭṭhāna Saṃyutta* (SN 47) [DharmaNexus]. Beyond Pali, comparative discussions and DharmaNexus cross-language alignments connect its material to *satipaṭṭhāna* expositions in the *Śāriputrābhidharma*, the Sanskrit *Arthaviniścayasūtra*, the *Pañcaviṃśatisāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā*, and the Tibetan translation of the *Śrāvakabhūmi* [Anālayo 2010; DharmaNexus].
